description: This PHP source file provides utility functions for the SuiteCRM project, including system info retrieval, version checking, license management, and configuration handling.

methods.name: getSystemInfo
methods.description: Collects and returns system information, including hardware, software, and usage stats for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getBaseSystemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves basic system information such as SugarCRM version, flavor, and database version.

methods.name: check_now
methods.description: Performs a remote check for updates and license validation, returning version info and updating license settings.

methods.name: compareVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings, returning true if the first is newer than the second.

methods.name: set_CheckUpdates_config_setting
methods.description: Sets the configuration for automatic update checks.

methods.name: get_CheckUpdates_config_setting
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration setting for update checks, defaulting to 'automatic'.

methods.name: set_last_check_version_config_setting
methods.description: Stores the last checked version in configuration.

methods.name: get_last_check_version_config_setting
methods.description: Retrieves the last checked version from configuration.

methods.name: set_last_check_date_config_setting
methods.description: Stores the date of the last update check.

methods.name: get_last_check_date_config_setting
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the last update check.

methods.name: set_sugarbeat
methods.description: Saves a 'sugarbeat' configuration value to the config file.

methods.name: get_sugarbeat
methods.description: Retrieves the 'sugarbeat' configuration value, defaulting to true if not explicitly set.

methods.name: shouldCheckSugar
methods.description: Determines whether the system should perform update checks based on configuration.

methods.name: loadLicense
methods.description: Loads license information into the global $license object.

methods.name: loginLicense
methods.description: Performs license validation and version checking, updating session and configuration as needed.
